sources.games: 51 league games since 7.40 (data/heroes/item_stats; most of his games are cores), win 37.3%; soft support by STRATZ pos4 (5489 games) and pos5 (1275). Under 150 games: the build leans on STRATZ pos4 (Blink Dagger 16 min 100%, Kaya 25 min 45%, won 57%), no rule. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py earthshaker.
sources.items: No item rule: no group has 20 games with a signal (illusion clearers 22 games, 4 Yasha buys).

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 90% (-2), ring_of_basilius 90% (7), arcane_boots 79% (11), blink 100% (16), aghanims_shard 47% (20), force_staff 37% (24), staff_of_wizardry 79% (24), glimmer_cape 21% (26), kaya 26% (26), cyclone 32% (28), blade_of_alacrity 21% (31), yasha 21% (31), tiara_of_selemene 21% (41), ring_of_tarrasque 21% (42). Reviewed against STRATZ pos4 (5489 games): Blink Dagger and Kaya agree; Eul's Scepter (32% at 28 min of 51 games) dropped, Arcane Boots, Aghanim's Shard and Force Staff are league-only (asked).

skills.basis: 51 games since 7.40: maxed earthshaker_fissure > earthshaker_aftershock > earthshaker_enchant_totem 19 (win 47.4%), earthshaker_aftershock > earthshaker_fissure > earthshaker_enchant_totem 13 (win 46.2%), earthshaker_fissure > earthshaker_aftershock 9 (win 44.4%); talents 10: +75 Fissure Damage 44/46 (40.9%), +25 Base Damage 2/46 (50.0%); 15: +50 Aftershock Damage 16/29 (50.0%), +200 Fissure Range 13/29 (53.8%); 20: +50 Echo Damage 9/9 (55.6%); 25: -50% Echo Slam Cooldown 2/3 (100.0%), -1.5s Enchant Totem Cooldown 1/3 (100.0%).
